# Selected technical work

This portfolio connects scientific questions, methods, implementation, and evaluation. Each substantial project has its own page where the available evidence supports it; publication records and projects with less implementation detail are grouped here. Confidential industrial work is described only at a level that can be shared publicly.

## Scientific publications

### Reduced-Order Modelling of Dispersion (2008)

**Jean-Marc Brun and Bijan Mohammadi**  
Book chapter in *Partial Differential Equations: Modelling and Numerical Simulation*, pp. 245–256.

The chapter presents reduced-complexity modelling for passive-scalar transport and environmental dispersion. Similarity-based modelling estimates concentrations without solving a full spatial PDE over the entire domain.

- [Chapter record — Springer](https://link.springer.com/chapter/10.1007/978-1-4020-8758-5_14)
- [Book record — Springer](https://link.springer.com/book/10.1007/978-1-4020-8758-5)

### Similitude généralisée et modélisation géométrique à complexité réduite (2006)

**Bijan Mohammadi and Jean-Marc Brun**  
*Comptes Rendus. Mécanique*, 334(10), 634–638. DOI: 10.1016/j.crme.2006.06.007.

This paper presents a reduced-complexity approach to passive-scalar transport and dispersion. It develops similarity solutions in a non-symmetric metric based on transport times and uses partial observational data for model identification.

- [Publisher record and abstract — Comptes Rendus. Mécanique](https://comptes-rendus.academie-sciences.fr/mecanique/articles/10.1016/j.crme.2006.06.007/)

### Contribution mentioned in a public-health exposure report (2006)

**Évaluation de l’exposition aérienne aux pesticides de la population générale — Étude en air extérieur dans quatre sites de l’Hérault en 2006**

The report examines pesticide concentrations in outdoor air at four sites in Hérault and discusses population exposure. Jean-Marc Brun is listed among people who also participated in the study; the report does not specify his individual role or contribution.

- [Study report — Santé publique France (PDF)](https://www.santepubliquefrance.fr/sites/default/files/rdd/document/82748_9958-9958-ps.pdf)

## Attribution and evidence

Scientific publications above link to publisher records that identify Jean-Marc Brun as an author. The public-health report is described only as a report that lists him among participants, not as an authored publication. Other supplied sources concerning atmospheric dispersion or pesticide spray drift are not listed as personal publications where the available metadata identifies other authors.

Software descriptions are based on public repository documentation and inspected source files. Capabilities that are incomplete or not yet validated are identified as limitations rather than presented as completed features.
